title: Lazare, veni foras: Reprogramming Dormant Neurons to Backdoor AI Agents

evidence.quote: Microsoft researchers have discovered “Lazarus,” a backdoor technique that can reprogram dormant neurons in an AI model, causing an otherwise normal AI agent to execute malicious commands when a hidden trigger appears.
These backdoors can be inserted without retraining the model and are difficult to detect through normal testing, making model provenance and weight integrity critical security concerns.
The threat is especially serious for AI agents with tool or terminal access.
